technical.summary: Mixed technicals with strong momentum divergence signals (StochRSI cross-up, volume spike, OBV bullish) offset by price trading below key moving averages and long-term downtrend structure; moderate confluence for swing entry but elevated risk from macro bearish alignment.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 61 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (40 VIX equivalent) with bearish sentiment (42%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of insider conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 61 days adds event risk; MMM as industrial multinational faces significant near-term volatility.

debate.key_bull_argument: StochRSI cross-up, 15x volume spike, OBV bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud create short-term momentum divergence with price near support (103.01), offering tactical contrarian entry in fear-zone conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trades below all key moving averages (EMA 9/21/50/200, SMA 50/200), long-term downtrend structure intact, inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels, earnings risk in 61 days, and zero fundamental catalysts create overwhelming macro and structural headwinds that outweigh momentum signals.

decision.entry_rationale: StochRSI cross-up and 15x volume spike offer tactical momentum divergence at support, but macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals) and structural bearishness (price below all key MAs, long-term downtrend) overwhelm short-term technicals.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 61 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signal and VIX at crisis levels creates compounding event and macro risk that invalidates swing trade thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear dominance despite momentum signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 7 existing Industrials positions (35% sector concentration); adding would violate concentration limits and reduce conviction further given macro environment.
